================================================================================
Final caveat accepts the EOF terminator without a missing newline
================================================================================
caveat sample() { value }
---
(source_file (caveat (caveat_literal) (identifier) (parameters_list) (block_c (expression_statement (identifier)))))

================================================================================
Final caveat accepts an explicit newline
================================================================================
caveat sample() { value }

---
(source_file (caveat (caveat_literal) (identifier) (parameters_list) (block_c (expression_statement (identifier)))))

================================================================================
Final caveat accepts an explicit semicolon
================================================================================
caveat sample() { value };
---
(source_file (caveat (caveat_literal) (identifier) (parameters_list) (block_c (expression_statement (identifier)))))

================================================================================
EOF terminates only the final declaration
================================================================================
caveat first() { value }
caveat second() { value }
---
(source_file (caveat (caveat_literal) (identifier) (parameters_list) (block_c (expression_statement (identifier)))) (caveat (caveat_literal) (identifier) (parameters_list) (block_c (expression_statement (identifier)))))

================================================================================
Final definition accepts EOF without inventing a newline
================================================================================
definition user {}
---
(source_file (definition (definition_literal) (identifier) (block)))

================================================================================
Definition relations and permissions are retained at EOF
================================================================================
definition document {
	relation viewer: user
	permission view = viewer
}
---
(source_file (definition (definition_literal) (identifier) (block (relation (relation_literal) (identifier) (rel_expression (identifier))) (permission (permission_literal) (identifier) (perm_expression (identifier))))))

================================================================================
Final import accepts EOF without inventing a newline
================================================================================
import "schema.zed"
---
(source_file (import_statement (interpreted_string_literal)))
